Post Title: Is Your Old Dental Filling Quietly Failing? 🛑🦷
"While dental fillings are remarkably durable, they are not designed to last forever. Over years of daily chewing and exposure to changing temperatures from hot and cold foods, older silver amalgam fillings can slowly expand, contract, or develop microscopic gaps right along the edges where they meet your natural tooth structure."

At Dr. Khushboo’s Dent House, we frequently treat patients who are completely unaware that their old restorations are breaking down. This structural breakdown leads to a process called micro-leakage. These microscopic gaps allow invisible, decay-causing bacteria and food particles to seep directly underneath the existing filling. Because your toothbrush bristles cannot reach beneath a sealed restoration, the bacteria thrive in secret, quietly damaging the inner nerve structure of your tooth without causing any initial pain.

The hidden risks of leaving old, failing fillings unmanaged:

Secondary Tooth Decay: Bacteria trapped beneath an old filling will slowly erode the healthy remaining tooth structure from the inside out, often requiring more extensive treatments if left too long.
